# Independent IKEv2 capture fixture

`wireshark_ikev2_aes256gcm16.pcap` is a 1,448-byte public test capture from
the Wireshark project's `v3.6.0` tag, originally added to test its IKEv2
dissector. It was not generated by this analyzer.

- Source: <https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/v3.6.0/test/captures/ikev2-decrypt-aes256gcm16.pcap>
- SHA-256: `86505314cc2cbe68b1c4af270d099cab234e64595277bb572f18dfaab2654179`
- Size: 1,448 bytes
- Scope: six IKEv2 packets. The first two expose IKE_SA_INIT proposals. The
  remaining exchanges contain encrypted payloads, which the analyzer does not
  decrypt or use as evidence of Child SA settings.

The regression asserts numeric transform IDs and key length in the cleartext
proposal, not a general claim about deployment strength. The IANA IKEv2
registry identifies encryption transform 20 as AES-GCM-16, PRF transform 5
as HMAC-SHA2-256, and key exchange transform 19 as the 256-bit random ECP
group: <https://www.iana.org/assignments/ikev2-parameters>.
